verses.1: Prayer for the Prophet’s healing of his ailments.
verses.2: Yehova, I have heard your voice; I am afraid of you. Yehova, your deeds have been done over the course of two years. May you be praised with all your heart. May you be honored with your compassion.
verses.3: Elohim will come from Mount Paran, and the Holy One will descend from that place. His praise will fill the earth, and his songs will fill the land.
verses.4: And its light would be like rays of light that came from his hand. And there would be a great bond between them.
verses.5: Before him, words will go forth, and a messenger will go before his feet.
verses.6: He stood and gazed upon the earth. He saw nations that rose up in rebellion. The hills were covered with ruins; fields were destroyed. It was a world of destruction.
verses.7: Under the shadow of the sun, I saw the tents of Qushan Yirgzon. They covered the land from Midyan.
verses.8: May the rivers be pure, O LORD! May your paths through the rivers and seas be safe. For you will ride upon your horses, and your chariots will bring salvation.
verses.9: Your land will be devastated; its crops will be destroyed. The rivers will dry up, and the land will become barren.
verses.10: Your feet will step on mountains; rivers of water will flow across them. He will give them land to live in. His voice will be loud and clear.
verses.11: The sun shone brightly, and Zbulah stood in the light of your wings. They walked towards Noga with the brightness of your ship.
verses.12: In anger, the land will be trampled underfoot, and nations will be destroyed.
verses.13: You went out to save your people, to save your Messiah. You removed them from the house of sinners. Their heads were cut off, right down to their chests.
verses.14: She pierced them with her hands; their heads were scattered everywhere. Their joy spread like a storm, just as if they were poor people in the darkness.
verses.15: You traveled across the sea on your horses, covered with water.
verses.16: I heard a loud noise in my stomach. My words became silent. Death will come upon me, and beneath me there will be chaos. It’s a day of suffering for those who try to rise up against us.
verses.17: For it will not bloom, and there will be no dew on the branches. It’s like something that was done by a magician. There’s no fruit from it; it doesn’t produce any food. There’s also no milk from it.
verses.18: And I, in the Lord, will raise her up from the grave. I will bring her back to the God of salvation.
verses.19: Yehovah, my God and my army, may your feet be like levers. May your hands lead me to destruction through your commands.
